constraints.description: A used knowledge-base hit emits AG-UI provenance with KB ID, document ID, and document name, and the chat UI displays the source document.

validation.validation_method: Focused normalized/SSE tests plus the exact Chromium BDD scenario

constraints.description: Agent-scoped chat retrieval uses decomposition, deduplication, verification, result limiting, and a named structured retrieval decision audit event before context injection.

validation.validation_method: Focused pipeline suite, structured tracing capture, and outgoing-prompt browser assertion

constraints.description: Successful document processing persists Indexed rather than Pending on embedded SurrealKV and PostgreSQL.

validation.validation_method: Fresh embedded SurrealKV status test and isolated PostgreSQL 17 lifecycle test

constraints.description: The change is limited to RAG events/pipeline/persistence, focused BDD fixtures, OpenSpec, and evidence; phase Tier 2 remains deferred.

validation.validation_method: Scoped diff audit, Rust/TypeScript Tier 0, focused tests, strict OpenSpec, schemas, references, and independent review

global_rules: Use the OpenSpec proposal, delta, and tasks as acceptance authority.
Do not claim provenance from source inspection alone; observe the browser and event mappings.
Report SurrealKV, PostgreSQL, Chromium, and server-full results separately.
Do not run phase Tier 2 before all active-phase changes are complete.
termination_conditions: Strict OpenSpec, artifact schemas/references/state, focused provider and browser checks, and scoped diff checks pass.
Independent artifact critic and judge find no implementation or evidence blocker.
